WHAT: Two frontend quality improvements enabling the keybind swap UX

WHERE:
- src/components/molecules/KeybindInput.tsx
- src/components/molecules/KeybindInput.css.ts
- src/components/atoms/HotkeyStatusBanner.tsx

HOW:
1. KeybindInput clear button:
   - Small X button rendered next to the keybind display when a keybind is set
   - Calls onChange("") to clear the keybind
   - Enables swap flow: clear one → set the other → set the first
   - Backend already handles empty keybinds (skips registration)
   - Style: clearButton in KeybindInput.css.ts

2. HotkeyStatusBanner:
   - Previously: generic "A hotkey shortcut couldn't register" for all failures
   - Now: extracts shortcut name from backend error strings
   - Backend emits: "Recording hotkey failed to register", "Toggle recording hotkey failed to register"
   - Banner displays: "Push-to-talk shortcut couldn't register", "Toggle shortcut couldn't register"

WHY: Without clear button, users couldn't swap keybinds because duplicate detection blocked it. Without specific banner text, users couldn't tell which shortcut failed.
